h-upmann-dr--1844-reserve.description: Reworked from the ground up in 2011, the 1844 Reserve is handmade in the Dominican Republic with an Ecuadorian Cubano wrapper, a Nicaraguan binder and an aged blend of Dominican filler. It burns evenly to a white ash, showing cedar, wood and a raw-sugar sweetness that turns to pepper in the last third.

thirds.notes: Cedar, at times sweet and at times spicy, with general wood notes and a touch of raw sugar cane.
The wood takes on an oak character and the cane sweetness overtakes the cedar, spice still present.
The cedar spice becomes classic pepper with a slightly rough finish as the body moves toward medium-full.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – H. Upmann 1844 Reserve (2011 reblend) review

h-upmann-dr--1844-classic.description: Part of the H. Upmann 1844 family, the Classic is made at Flor de Copán in Honduras with an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper over Honduran binder and filler, and was announced in 2021. A medium cigar slightly bolder than most shade smokes, it brings toasted almond and cocoa with cream, vanilla, citrus and a light baker's spice.

thirds.notes: Cream and vanilla move forward, citrus and baker's spice behind, with pepper and cedar on the retrohale.
The cream fades to leave vanilla in charge, citrus close behind and a slight rise in spice.
Little changes: vanilla and citrus lead to a soft, cool finish once the cream has gone.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – H. Upmann 1844 Classic Toro review

h-upmann-dr--vintage-cameroon.description: A nod to the early days of H. Upmann, when every cigar of the brand wore Cameroon leaf: a Cameroon wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder and Dominican, Nicaraguan and Peruvian filler, made in the Dominican Republic. Smooth and medium in body, it is distinctly flavorful, with a complex aroma, in seven sizes from Petite Corona to Toro.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – H. Upmann Vintage Cameroon

h-upmann-dr--the-banker.description: Launched in 2014 and made in the Dominican Republic, The Banker recalls the cigars the Upmann bankers kept in their vaults for their most important clients in 1844. An oily Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican filler, giving a medium-strength smoke of earth, leather, pepper and a nutty, coffee-tinged depth.

thirds.notes: Earth and leather lead, with pepper, cedar, a touch of chocolate and roasted nuts on the retrohale.
Earth stays dominant with an anise-like spice and a subtle citrus sweetness as the chocolate drifts back.
Earthy and fuller, with coffee arriving, pepper returning and leather and cedar near the finish.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – The Banker by H. Upmann
Cigar Coop – H. Upmann The Banker review
Leaf Enthusiast – The Banker by H. Upmann review

h-upmann-dr--by-aj-fernandez.description: Released in 2017 and made at A.J. Fernández's factory in Estelí, this H. Upmann uses an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, a Corojo '99 binder and a filler that includes Criollo '98 and Piloto Cubano. Very smooth and sweet-leaning, it moves through cream, honey and almond toward cedar, earth and a late flash of pepper.

thirds.notes: Sweet, creamy and honeyed, with walnut, light wood and a sharp pepper on the retrohale that soon mellows.
Very smooth, with tangy cream, cedar and honey, then berry notes as sweet earth replaces the wood.
Sweet nuts, cedar and earth, with pepper and a lemon brightness returning as intensity builds.

h-upmann-dr--1844-anejo.description: A newer addition to the repackaged 1844 line, made in Honduras with a dark, double-fermented Ecuadorian Habano wrapper, a sweet Broadleaf binder and a balanced filler from Nicaragua, the Dominican Republic and Honduras. Complex and medium to full in body, it offers a deep aroma and a bold finish, in Robusto, Toro and Magnum sizes.
